REFUND.definition: The consumer asked for their money back and the merchant refused or ignored the request.
includes: a refund refused for a faulty product
a refund refused for an order that never arrived
excludes: a repair refused under warranty: WARRANTY
a fault with no refund requested: DEFECT

DEFECT.definition: The product is faulty, damaged or not as described, and no refund or warranty repair was refused.
includes: a different model from the listing
excludes: the consumer asked for a refund and was refused: REFUND
a warranty repair was refused: WARRANTY

DELIVERY.definition: The order arrived late or not at all, and no refund was refused.
includes: delivered days after the promised date
excludes: a refund for the missing order was refused: REFUND

PRICE.definition: The consumer was charged more than the price displayed at the point of sale (shelf, app or listing).
includes: shelf price lower than the till
app price lower than the invoice
excludes: an advert promised a discount and the displayed price matched the charge: AD

AD.definition: An advert or offer made a claim the merchant did not honour, and the displayed price was charged.
excludes: the charge differs from the displayed price: PRICE

WARRANTY.definition: The product is under warranty and the merchant or service centre refused the repair or replacement.
includes: service centre refused a repair within the warranty period
excludes: a fault with no warranty claim: DEFECT

rules: 1. A repair or replacement refused under warranty is WARRANTY, whatever else the complaint says.
2. A refund the consumer asked for and was refused is REFUND, even when the product was faulty or never arrived.
3. A faulty, damaged or not-as-described product is DEFECT.
4. A late or missing delivery is DELIVERY.
5. A charge above the displayed price is PRICE, even when an advert was involved.
6. An advert or offer not honoured, at the displayed price, is AD.

edge_cases.case: Broken on arrival and the refund was refused
edge_cases.label: REFUND

edge_cases.case: Under warranty, repair refused, and the refund also refused
edge_cases.label: WARRANTY

edge_cases.case: Advert said 50% off; the shelf showed one price and the till charged more
edge_cases.label: PRICE

edge_cases.case: Order never arrived and the money was not returned
edge_cases.label: REFUND

edge_cases.case: Late delivery and the product arrived broken
edge_cases.label: DEFECT

language_notes.gulf: خرب = stopped working (faulty); طلبت فلوسي ورفضوا = refund asked and refused; حاسبوني = charged; ما وصل = not delivered
language_notes.mixed: refund, warranty, delivery and offer may appear in English inside Arabic: read them as the same facts; 'no refund policy' is a refusal
language_notes.english: 'money back' is a refund request; 'marked delivered' with nothing received is not delivered

wellbeing.who: raters who opted in and were briefed by the labelling lead (R2 and R4 in this round)
wellbeing.breaks: a break after every 20 minutes of distressing items
wellbeing.escalation: a complaint that describes a risk to someone's safety goes to the duty officer the same day
